Reach Lanka to complete the setu

In the Ramayana, when Lord Rama needed to reach Lanka to free Sita from Ravana, the vanara army had to build a bridge across the sea. The ocean god advised Rama to have Nala, son of Vishvakarma, lead the work.

Nala and Nila had a boon that stones they touched would float. The army wrote Rama's name on each stone and set them on the water.

In Yuddha Kanda, Nala built the bridge in five days: 14, then 20, 21, 22, and 23 yojanas—one hundred yojanas in all, reaching Lanka.

• Tap floating stones near the gold line.
• Catch a stone on the line for a Perfect hit.
• Do not let any stone sink into the deep.
• Reach Lanka (170 stones) to complete the five-day setu. If a stone sinks before that, the work is unfinished — build again.
Tap near the gold line. Perfect hits live on that line.
Place your first stone in the bridge.
Reach the second day of the bridge.
Complete the five-day bridge and reach Lanka.

Ram Setu (“the app”) is published by Vanarsena.

This Privacy Policy explains how the app accesses, collects, uses, and shares user and device data. The app does not access personal or sensitive user data.

What we collect
The app does not collect, transmit, or share personal information. It has no internet access, no accounts, no ads, and no analytics.

Data stored only on your device
To run the game, the app stores on this device:
• High score, total stones, and achievements
• Sound, music, haptic, language, and tutorial settings
• An interrupted run so a game can resume after the app is interrupted

This data never leaves the device except if you use your phone’s built-in device-to-device transfer. Vanarsena cannot read it.

Permissions
Vibrate — used only for optional haptic feedback. You can turn haptics off in Settings.

Sharing
We do not share user data with third parties. The app includes no advertising, analytics, or social SDKs.

Security
There is no server, so no data is sent over a network. Local settings remain on your device.

Retention and deletion
On-device data is kept until you delete it. You can erase it in Settings → Reset saved data, or by uninstalling the app. There are no accounts to delete.

Children
The app is a general-audience game. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

Contact
Questions about this policy: themukulbhardwaj@gmail.com

Effective date: 12 September 2026
Ram Setu is an original entertainment game inspired by the Ramayana. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official app of any government, temple, or religious organization.
